section.content: 全尺寸的学习图像被图像缩小部(11)缩小后输入到FCN(全卷积神经网络)运算部(13)，FCN运算部(13)进行所设定的滤波器系数下的运算并输出缩小标签图像。缩小标签图像被图像放大部(14)放大到全尺寸，误差计算部(15)基于损失函数，来计算该放大后的标签图像与全尺寸的正确图像之间的误差，参数更新部(16)根据该误差来更新滤波器系数。通过学习控制部(17)的控制来重复学习，由此能够制作包含图像放大时产生的误差地执行最佳的分割那样的学习模型。另外，通过在学习模型中包括图像放大处理，能够输出全尺寸的标签图像，也能够高精度地进行模型的精度评价。

The full-size learning image is reduced by an image reduction unit (11), and then input to an FCN (full convolutional neural network) operation unit (13), and the FCN operation unit (13) performs an operation with the set filter coefficients and outputs a reduced label image. The reduced tag image is enlarged to the full size by an image enlarging unit (14), an error calculating unit (15) calculates an error between the enlarged tag image and the full-size correct image based on the loss function, and a parameter updating unit (16) updates the filter coefficient based on the error. By repeating learning under the control of a learning control unit (17), a learning model can be created which includes errors occurring during image magnification and performs optimal segmentation. Further, by including the image enlarging process in the learning model, a full-size label image can be output, and also the accuracy evaluation of the model can be performed with high accuracy.

Machine learning method and machine learning deviceTechnical Field

The present invention relates to a machine learning method, a machine learning device, and a computer program for machine learning, which are directed to image information, and more particularly to a machine learning method, a machine learning device, and a machine learning program for creating a learning model for performing semantic segmentation (semantic segmentation) on an image by supervised learning.

Background

In recent years, image processing techniques such as semantic segmentation using machine learning, particularly deep learning (deep learning), have been utilized in various fields such as automatic driving and medical image diagnosis. In image processing using deep learning, convolutional neural networks (Convolutional Neural Network: hereinafter abbreviated as "CNN") are widely used. CNNs typically have: a convolution layer that extracts features of an image by convolution processing using a plurality of filters; a pooling layer for imparting positional invariance to local data by pooling processing that gathers responses of a certain area; and a full connection layer that connects the image data from which the feature portion is extracted by the convolution layer and the pooling layer to one node, and outputs a value (feature variable) obtained by the activation function conversion. In addition, a full (complete) convolutional neural network (Fully Convolutional Neural Network: hereinafter abbreviated as "FCN") in which a full-link layer constituting a CNN is changed to a convolutional layer has recently been proposed (see non-patent document 1), and in particular, application to semantic segmentation has been advanced.

In summary, in machine learning including CNN and FCN, a model function f (w, x) is generally constructed on input data x using a parameter w, and a loss of correct data prepared in advance in the model function is defined and the parameter w is corrected to minimize the loss, thereby obtaining an appropriate model function. Such a method is known as an error Back Propagation algorithm (Back Propagation). In semantic division, the correct data is data constituting a tag image, which is a result of correctly dividing an input image.

In general, in learning of deep learning for image data, the amount of calculation is enormous. Thus, the input image data is typically processed by a GPU (Graphics Processing Unit: graphics processing unit) designed to be dedicated to the image calculation processing. However, in this case, it is also difficult to process a large number of images at a time, and therefore the following processing is performed: the input image is divided by a predetermined number of sheets, and a loss function is calculated for each divided image of the set. The number of images considered as one set is called batch size (batch size), and is set in advance as an important parameter in machine learning.

Although learning is quick and efficient when increasing the batch size, there is a limit to the batch size that can be set due to the limit of the memory capacity of the GPU. In addition, when the size of the input image is extremely large, the data size required for learning may exceed the memory capacity of the GPU even if the batch size is set to the minimum value, and processing may not be performed. For example, the present application has proposed methods for identifying cells from an undifferentiated state generated during the culture of pluripotent stem cells by applying machine learning to cell observation images obtained by a holographic microscope in PCT/JP2018/008483, PCT/JP2018/009046, and the like. In such a case, since the original cell observation image has a very high definition and a wide imaging range, the size of image data is large, and the size of a temporary memory used for learning is also large, so that the data size required for learning one image may exceed the memory capacity of the GPU.

Therefore, conventionally, in order to make the batch size as large as possible or in order to process an image having an extremely large data size, a method of reducing the size of an input image and a correct image corresponding thereto in the same manner and performing learning using the reduced image has been adopted. As an algorithm for image reduction, bilinear interpolation, bicubic interpolation, nearest neighbor interpolation, lanczos (Lanczos) interpolation, and the like are known.

Disclosure of Invention

Problems to be solved by the invention

However, the above-described conventional machine learning method has the following problems.

In machine learning, in general, after a learning model is created by learning using a learning image and a correct image, whether or not the learning model is appropriate is evaluated with respect to accuracy. In the accuracy evaluation of the learning model, a test image and an accurate image corresponding to the test image are used, but a label image output from the learning model as a result of inputting the test image to the learning model is a reduced image. Therefore, the reduced label image is enlarged by bilinear interpolation or the like to restore the same full-size (full size) image as the correct image, and then the two images are compared to evaluate the label image. However, there is a case where a difference in the minute area between the two images becomes significant due to an error in the pixel signal generated when the reduced label image is enlarged, and the evaluation accuracy is lowered.

The present invention has been made to solve the above-described problems, and an object thereof is to provide a machine learning method, a machine learning apparatus, and a machine learning program, as follows: a learning model capable of outputting a full-size, high-precision label image even when the input image is required to be reduced due to the large size of the image during learning can be produced.

Solution for solving the problem

A machine learning method according to the present invention, which is achieved to solve the above-described problems, is a machine learning method for creating a learning model for semantic segmentation of an input image by machine learning, the machine learning method including:

a) An image reduction step of reducing the size of the inputted learning image; and

b) A learning execution step including a tag image generation step of generating a tag image using a plurality of reduced learning images in accordance with a learning model based on a predetermined parameter, an image enlargement step of enlarging the tag image to the size of the inputted learning image, and a parameter updating step of obtaining an error using a loss function based on the enlarged tag image and a correct image corresponding to the learning image, and updating the parameter based on the error,

in the machine learning method, an enlarged learning model obtained by adding an enlargement process based on the image enlargement step to the learning model improved in the learning execution step is obtained as a learning model for performing semantic segmentation.

In order to solve the above-described problems, a machine learning device according to the present invention for creating a learning model for semantic segmentation of an input image by machine learning, the machine learning device comprising:

a) An image reduction unit that reduces the size of an input learning image; and

b) A learning execution unit including a tag image generation unit that generates a tag image in accordance with a learning model based on a predetermined parameter using a plurality of reduced learning images, an image amplification unit that amplifies the tag image to a size of the inputted learning image, a parameter update unit that obtains an error using a loss function based on the amplified tag image and a correct image corresponding to the learning image, updates the parameter in accordance with the error, and a repetition control unit that gradually improves the learning model by repeating processing of each of the units,

the machine learning device obtains an enlarged learning model obtained by adding the enlarging process of the image enlarging portion to the learning model improved in the learning execution portion as a learning model for performing semantic segmentation.

A machine learning program according to the present invention, which has been completed to solve the above-described problems, is a machine learning program for creating a learning model for semantic segmentation of an input image by machine learning on a computer, the machine learning program causing the computer to operate as each of the following functional units:

a) An image reduction function unit that reduces the size of an input learning image; and

b) A learning execution function section including a tag image generation function section that generates a tag image in accordance with a learning model based on a predetermined parameter using a plurality of reduced learning images, an image amplification function section that amplifies the tag image to a size of the inputted learning image, a parameter update function section that obtains an error by a loss function based on the amplified tag image and a correct image corresponding to the learning image, updates the parameter in accordance with the error, and a repetition control function section that gradually improves the learning model by repeating processing of the respective function sections,

the machine learning program obtains an enlarged learning model obtained by adding the enlarging process of the image enlarging function to the learning model improved in the learning execution function as a learning model for performing semantic division.

The method of machine learning in the present invention is not particularly limited as long as it is capable of performing semantic segmentation of an image based on a learning model, and examples thereof include a support vector machine (Support Vector Machine: SVM), random Forest (Random Forest), adaptive boosting (AdaBoost), and the like, in addition to the deep learning including FCN and CNN described above.

In the present invention, as images for creating a learning model, a plurality (usually a considerable number) of sets of images having the same size (full size) of learning images and correct images as one set are input. The correct image is a label image, and the label image is a result obtained by implementing accurate semantic segmentation on the learning image. In the machine learning method according to the present invention, the input full-size learning image is first reduced to a predetermined size by the image reduction step. The algorithm for reducing the image is not particularly limited, and any method including the above-described several methods can be used.

In the learning execution step, the learning model for semantically dividing the unknown image is created by performing machine learning using the plurality of learning images reduced as described above. For example, in the case of performing FCN-based deep learning, in the tag image generation step, a tag image is generated by a multilayer network including a plurality of convolution layers and a plurality of pooling layers having coefficients (weights) of filters as parameters, but first, a tag image is generated by a multilayer network including a convolution layer in which the coefficients of the filters are set to a predetermined value. The input image input to the network is a reduced image, and therefore the tag image output from the network is also a reduced image.

In the image enlarging step, the reduced label image is enlarged to the size of the original learning image, that is, the full size. Then, in the parameter updating step, an error is obtained from the enlarged full-size label image and the same full-size correct image using a predetermined loss function, and the parameter, that is, the filter coefficient of the convolution layer is updated based on the error. Then, the following process is repeated: the label image is generated again through the multi-layer network with updated filter coefficients, and the label image is amplified and the error between the label image and the correct image is obtained. The filter coefficient sets, i.e., the learning models, are gradually improved by this iterative process so that the more accurate models are approached. Then, an enlarged learning model obtained by adding the enlargement processing in the image enlargement step to the final learning model is acquired as a learning model for performing semantic segmentation.

In the present invention, since learning is performed so as to include the amplification processing in the image amplification step, the parameters of the learning model are determined so as to reduce as much as possible the error or the like of the pixel signal that may occur at the time of the amplification processing. In the learning model manufactured by the conventional learning method, the label image outputted for the inputted test image is a reduced image, but in the learning model manufactured by the present invention, the outputted label image is the same full-size image as the inputted test image. Therefore, the accuracy evaluation of the learning model can be performed directly using the tag image and the full-size correct image output from the learning model.

ADVANTAGEOUS EFFECTS OF INVENTION

As described above, according to the present invention, since the input image can be reduced in size and learned, the batch size can be increased, or an image having an extremely large image size can be processed. On the other hand, since the tag image output from the learning model is not a reduced image but a full-size high-definition image identical to the original input image, for example, the accuracy evaluation of the learning model can be performed with high accuracy.

Detailed Description

An embodiment of a machine learning method, a machine learning apparatus, and a machine learning program according to the present invention will be described below with reference to the drawings.

FIG. 1 is a schematic module configuration diagram of one embodiment of a machine learning device for implementing the machine learning method of the present invention.

The machine learning device of the present embodiment includes, as functional blocks, an image reduction unit 11, a learning execution unit 12, and a learning control unit 17, wherein the learning execution unit 12 includes an FCN calculation unit 13, an image amplification unit 14, an error calculation unit 15, and a parameter update unit 16. The machine learning device can be realized by executing software installed in such a computer alone or in a computer system, using a personal computer, a higher-performance workstation, or a computer system including a high-performance computer connected to such a computer via a communication line as a hardware resource.

Fig. 2 is a conceptual diagram of the structure of the FCN arithmetic unit 13. Details of the structure and processing of FCNs are described in many documents, including non-patent document 1. Alternatively, it can be realized by commercially available or free software such as "MATLAB" offered by Michawk (MathWorks) Inc. in the United states. Therefore, the following description will be made in outline.

As shown in fig. 2, the FCN includes, for example, a multilayer network 131 in which a convolutional layer and a pooling layer are repeatedly arranged and multilayered, and a convolutional layer 132 corresponding to a fully connected layer in the convolutional neural network. In this case, in the multilayer network 131, a convolution process using a filter (kernel) of a predetermined size and a pooling process of two-dimensionally reducing the convolution result and extracting an effective value are repeatedly performed. However, the multilayer network 131 may be composed of only convolutional layers without a pooling layer. In the final convolution layer 132, a filter of a predetermined size is slid in the input image, and partial convolution and deconvolution are performed. In this FCN, the input image 133 is semantically divided, so that the tagged tag image 134 can be output.

In order to divide by FCN, a large number of learning images need to be used in advance to learn the coefficients (weights) of the filters of each of the plurality of convolution layers included in the multilayer network 131 and the final-stage convolution layer 132. Next, the operation performed in learning in the machine learning device according to the present embodiment will be described with reference to the flowchart shown in fig. 3. Here, learning is performed by a random gradient descent method generally used in machine learning. The method is a method of repeating batch-wise learning of a large amount of learning data to be supplied in a predetermined small batch (mini-batch), and has an advantage of not easily sinking into a partial solution by randomly shuffling the learning data.

In learning, a large number of aggregate images are used, which are a group of learning images that are objects of division, and correct images that are label images of results obtained by appropriately dividing the learning images. Here, for convenience of explanation, the group of the learning image and the correct image is set to M.

The learning control unit 17 randomly decides the learning images allocated to the plurality of small batches based on the predetermined batch size (step S1). Here, the number of small batches is N, and the number of learning images allocated to one small batch is N.

The image reduction unit 11 reads n learning images included in one small batch according to the assignment determined by the learning control unit 17, and reduces the size of each image to a predetermined size. Next, the learning execution unit 12 executes FCN learning based on the reduced plurality of learning images and the correct images corresponding to the respective original learning images (step S13).

Specifically, first, the FCN arithmetic unit 13 performs processing on the input image with the filter coefficient initially set by the parameter updating unit 16, and outputs a label image as a result of the division. Since the input image is a reduced image, the tag image to be output is also a reduced image. The image enlarging unit 14 enlarges the size of the image to the same full size as the original learning image for each of the plurality of tag images. The error calculation unit 15 calculates an error by a predetermined loss function based on the enlarged tag image and the correct image corresponding to the enlarged tag image. That is, in calculating the error, the tag image and the correct image are both full-size images. The parameter updating unit 16 updates the filter coefficients in the FCN calculating unit 13 based on the calculated errors. Thus, the FCN arithmetic unit 13 changes the label image, which is the result of processing the same input image. The learning control unit 17 repeats such a routine until, for example, the error falls within a predetermined allowable range, thereby learning the filter coefficients by the FCN arithmetic unit 13 for one small batch. That is, the filter coefficients of the FCN arithmetic unit 13 are learned by the error back propagation algorithm.

After that, the learning control section 17 determines whether or not learning for all the small batches has ended (step S14). If no is determined in step S14, the process returns to step S12 because there is a small lot that has not yet been learned among the small lots for which the distribution of the learning image has been determined in step S11. Then, under the control of the learning control section 17, the image reduction section 11 reads in the learning image included in another small batch and reduces the learning image. Thus, the processing of steps S12 to S14 is repeated for the number N of small batches.

When the determination in step S14 is yes, the learning control unit 17 determines whether or not the processing in step S11 is repeated for a predetermined number of cycles (epoch) (step S15). If the determination is no in step S15, the process returns from step S15 to step S11, and the learning control unit 17 again randomly decides the learning images allocated to the plurality of small batches. Thus, the learning images allocated as each small lot are shuffled. The cycle number is determined appropriately in advance, but is usually a large value such as 1000 times or 1 ten thousand times. That is, the processes of steps S11 to S15 are repeated for the cycle number, and the FCN arithmetic unit 13 learns the filter coefficients during the repetition. Then, when the determination is yes in step S15, the learning is ended. Then, the learning result is stored as a model for which learning is completed (step S16).

The loop for learning the filter coefficients of the FCN arithmetic unit 13 as described above includes the amplification processing by the image amplification unit 14. In general, in the enlargement processing, the inverse operation of the reduction processing is performed, but an error is unavoidable in the pixel signal generated by interpolation, and in the machine learning device of the present embodiment, a FCN-based learning model is created so that an error generated at the time of the image enlargement is also included. Thus, the learning model created here is a model including the enlargement processing of the image enlargement unit 14. That is, an enlarged learning model obtained by combining the FCN and an enlargement process for enlarging a tag image that is an output of the FCN is a learning model for semantically dividing an input image, and an output of the learning model is a full-size tag image.

Thus, for example, when the accuracy of the created learning model is evaluated using the test image, it is possible to perform high-accuracy evaluation using the full-size label image output for the input test image and the full-size correct image corresponding to the test image.

In the above embodiment, FCN is used as the machine learning method for semantic segmentation, but it is obvious that FCN may be a general CNN. The present invention is not limited to the machine learning method using the neural network, and is effective as long as the machine learning method can divide an image. Examples of such machine learning methods include a support vector machine, a random forest, and an adaptive boosting.

It is to be understood that the above-described embodiments are merely examples of the present invention, and that modifications, corrections, and additions may be appropriately made within the scope of the present invention, and are also included in the scope of the claims of the present application.
